description: [Windows Tauri Apps Only] Interact with an elementRef from the latest native_dialog_snapshot using UI Automation InvokePattern, ValuePattern, or SelectionItemPattern. Use invoke for dialog buttons, setValue with a complete absolute file or folder path, setPaths with complete absolute existing file paths for multi-select Open dialogs, and select for advertised navigation or file-system controls. References are session-bound, expire after 30 seconds, and are otherwise ephemeral; take a new snapshot after a stale-reference error. Requires an active driver_session and an interactive Windows desktop. Targets the only connected app, or the default app if multiple are connected. Specify appIdentifier (port or bundle ID) to target a specific app.

action.description: Invoke a button through UI Automation InvokePattern

appIdentifier.description: App identifier (port or bundle ID) when multiple Tauri apps are connected

elementRef.description: Opaque elementRef from the latest native_dialog_snapshot

timeoutMs.description: Bounded time to wait for the native operation, from 100 to 10000 milliseconds

windowId.description: Tauri window label whose owned native dialog chain should be targeted

action.description: Set an editable filename/path through UI Automation ValuePattern

value.description: Complete absolute filename/path; the value is never logged

action.description: Set one or more existing files in a multi-select Open dialog

paths.description: Complete absolute file paths for a multi-file Open dialog; path values are never logged

action.description: Select a control through UI Automation SelectionItemPattern

name: native_dialog_interact
